Current Application Cycle: IIA is inviting applications with a deadline of 2nd June 2026. For the current cycle, the applications are invited only for the Regular Postdoctoral Program. The Chandrasekhar Postdoctoral Fellowship will not be offered in this round.

Post-Doctoral Researcher(PDR) positions are for candidates who have submitted their Ph.D thesis and are awaiting the award of the degree/thesis defense in Physical Sciences from a recognized University / Institute. The duration of the fellowship is only for a maximum of one year. Candidates should preferably be below the age of 36 years.

IIA offers a fellowship of Rs 46,000/- per month for a period of one year. House rent and medical facilities are offered in accordance with the prevailing rules of the institute. PDRs need to make their own arrangement for their accommodation.

The regular post-doctoral fellowships are open to researchers with a Ph.D degree in Physical Sciences from a recognized University / Institute. The candidate's research experience should have a significant overlap with the current research activities at IIA. The candidate should have a Ph.D. degree or should have completed the thesis defense at the time of application. The duration of the fellowship is normally for two years, with a possible extension for another year. Candidates should preferably be below the age of 36 years.

Selected candidates, as post-doctoral fellows (PDFs), are expected to work in close collaboration with members of the research groups at the institute and are also encouraged to carry out independent research.

IIA offers a fellowship of Rs 58,000/- per month for a fresh Ph.D. A fellowship of Rs. 61,000/- per month will be offered for those with a minimum of 1 - 2 years of post-doctoral experience. A fellowship of Rs. 67,000/- per month will be offered for those with more experience. Other allowances, such as house rent, book grant (Rs 10,000/year), and medical facilities, are offered in accordance with the prevailing rules of the institute. PDFs need to make their own arrangement for their accommodation.

The Chandrasekhar Post-Doctoral fellowship is for exceptionally bright candidates with outstanding academic credentials. Chandra Fellows may choose their own research topics or collaborate with groups or individuals in the institute. This fellowship is for a period of two years, with a possibility of an extension for one more year. Candidates should be ordinarily below the age of 32 years.

The monthly stipend is Rs. 75,000/- per month for candidates with up to 2 years of post-doctoral experience and Rs. 80,000/- per month for those with more than 2 years of experience. Chandra Fellows would be entitled to an annual contingency grant of Rs . 2,00,000/-, as well as to housing (subject to availability), medical and other benefits in accordance with the prevailing rules of the institute. Travel support by economy airfare will be available at the time of taking up the assignment.
